scope: Conditional MPZ model mapping and resource preservation only

source_bound.source: Maurer-Portmann-Zhu, Unifying Generic Group Models, IACR ePrint 2020/996
source_bound.game: average-case preprocessing dense generic-group extraction game pG_dense,ro^k
source_bound.ro_semantics: one shared RO(pi(v)) with domain and range Z_N
average_case_randomness: the shared random oracle when present

notation.ell_pred: all target-independent object-specific bits crossing from preprocessing to main
notation.K_pred: sum of every +, 1, dense, and ro interaction internal to all adaptive predicate answers and their replay
notation.m_MPZ: source-model register bound, equal to infinity and unrelated to m_radix

phase_boundary.target_independent_public_metadata: may be hard-coded when representation-independent; representation-dependent bytes must be in ell or rebuilt
phase_boundary.main_phase_registers: unbounded by the cited theorem but every operation creating or querying them counts in k

advice_census.condition: ell_pred <= B^(9/4+o(1)) is a frozen premise, not a measured result

advice_census.alternative: reconstruct in main from public deterministic lineage
build in main after charged reconstruction and dense queries

advice_census.charge: full ordinary bit serialization in ell
advice_census.alternative: requery in main and charge every ro call in K_pred or K_aux

advice_census.charge: not phase-crossing when first created in main; disclose as main memory and charge all black-box creation/query interactions

main_interaction_census.notes: The 3L top-level restriction routine calls are not MPZ primitives. Every black-box interaction inside them must be included in K_pred; treating each answer as one free oracle call is forbidden.

main_interaction_census.operations: two conservative at-most-2n known-scalar constructions and two additions with Q
at most 2n additions per known scalar; deliberately conservative and shareable implementations are cheaper

main_interaction_census.notes: The returned pi(v) values are injective exact keys. No shared RO is required for the deterministic sort fallback.

main_interaction_census.condition: uses the producer's at-most-2m match bound, whose injectivity premise is J1-owned
main_interaction_census.operations: for every possible match, at most 2n additions to construct [x_hat]P and two dense queries for exact comparison with Q

main_interaction_census.mpz_charge: zero by themselves; their internal black-box work is K_pred
main_interaction_census.conservative_aggregate_bookkeeping: may add 3L without changing the exponent

solver_side_non_mpz_costs.deterministic_exact_dictionary: sort 2m dense n-bit keys and binary-search 2m complements
solver_side_non_mpz_costs.main_memory_upper_bound: O(m_radix*(n+q)) bits plus predicate main state
solver_side_non_mpz_costs.decoding: at most 2m modular mixed-radix decodes under the producer's match bound
solver_side_non_mpz_costs.source_scope_warning: The cited MPZ theorem does not bound these ordinary bit operations, main solver memory, or preprocessing work. They are disclosed to prevent them from masquerading as free end-to-end resources.

collision_and_replay_accounting.dense_key_collisions: none for unequal group values because pi is a permutation
collision_and_replay_accounting.shared_ro_collisions: retain complete buckets if ro is used, but the validated fallback avoids reliance on RO collision behavior
collision_and_replay_accounting.occurrence_labels: all 4m public labels and signs retained even when cross-deck encodings agree
collision_and_replay_accounting.within_F3_output_bound: at most one F3 occurrence per exact complement and at most 2m total outputs, conditional on the J1-owned F3 injectivity fact
collision_and_replay_accounting.if_J1_injectivity_fails: up to O(m_radix^2) emitted pairs and verification work can occur; J2 accounting then breaks
collision_and_replay_accounting.preprocessing_handles: cannot cross as handles; serialize ordinary bits or reconstruct
collision_and_replay_accounting.main_replay: charged through K_pred for the premise object and through the explicit reconstruction/verification rows for the public join

success_semantics.mpz_quantity: probability that the complete adaptive main solver finally submits the correct x
success_semantics.producer_quantity: deterministic success one for every Q, conditional on an exact target-independent predicate object and the J1 algebraic facts
success_semantics.mapping: success one for every admitted pi and x implies average-case success one
success_semantics.marginal_failure_consequence: without a nonvanishing joint success lower bound for the whole 3L-call transcript, no contradiction follows

applicability_stops: predicate answers supplied by an external oracle instead of solver code plus allowed MPZ interactions
persistent uncharged generic handles across the phase reset
multiple, arbitrary-string, target-dependent, coordinate, Semaev, or representation-leaking oracles
per-call or marginal success with no complete-transcript lower bound
an inference about preprocessing time, ordinary bit complexity, or main memory from the MPZ success theorem
failure of the J1-owned within-F3 injectivity/output bound
limitations: K_pred and ell_pred are frozen conditional premises; no implementation or measurement establishes them.
J2 does not adjudicate F3 injectivity, the universal witness, bisection correctness, decoding, scope controls, or any sibling verdict.
The source gives no end-to-end preprocessing-time, bit-time, or main-memory bound.
No whole-claim or official-state conclusion is issued.
